__why: Credit refusal bodies as mcpjam-backend's buildSpendRefusalBody writes them (branch olartgabo/kes-941-recovery), plus one from a backend that predates `recovery`. Shared by the SDK, Inspector and CLI tests so every surface is checked against the same refusal: each must lead with `formatCreditRecovery(body.recovery)`, which `expectedRecovery` pins. `stopsRun` is whether the refusal is credit exhaustion (a spend cap fails the trial but does not stop the run).
